source: Older fixed-capacity ZXNAME0000XZ implementations made token dropping visible because static expert buffers could overflow. In Switch Transformer, an overflowed token does not receive that sparse expert computation and is passed onward through the residual connection.
zh: 较旧的固定容量 ZXNAME0000XZ 实现使令牌丢弃变得可见，因为静态专家缓冲区可能会溢出。在 Switch Transformer 中，溢出的令牌不会接收稀疏专家计算，而是通过剩余连接向前传递。
